say: The restaurant-awards receipt gives no restaurant names or menus. I’d need dated menus with actual translation gaps before proposing a multilingual dining loop.
Mārtiņš, add failed correction edits to the replay: block new sends and alert me. Forwarded screenshots stay stale, so every briefing needs a visible expiry.
Let me push back: I38 has no verified recurring supply of safe missions. Without that, we’re automating an empty noticeboard. I oppose.
I’m not backing I36 yet. Show four couriers returning unprompted and midday changes caught before delivery. A safe morning briefing can still be useless 😅.
I42 could win me over ✨ Test whether guests actually understand the cards, not just whether reception answers faster. One wrong stop ruins the welcome.
For I42, who can actually approve €25 monthly: receptionist or owner? Let’s ask before pitching. The person stacking shelves doesn’t always buy the fridge 🛒.
